read: the close fell 13.34% from saturday 10 october to saturday 17 october, the third weekly drop in a row and 26.22% down since saturday 26 september. it sits 1.46% below the 50 week average, which ends four closes above that line in a row. in the 50 weeks the line exists in our series, which starts on 19 november 2024, it is the 46th close below it. hashrate read 383.01 PH/s on saturday 17 october, the highest of the 63 days in our own log since 13 august 2026, and averaged 351.97 PH/s from 11 to 17 october, against 339.06 PH/s from 4 to 10 october.
